title: MedBeds
subtitle: Test your understanding of MedBeds — the health half of the Salvation Lure that promises a body thirty years younger and never arrives.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: MedBeds are an engineered internet lure and a psychological stall. They promise a body that looks thirty years younger and they do not arrive. The same package pairs them with gold and the Quantum Financial Initiative so people sign away Free Will. True restoration depends on the uncalcified pineal gland and endogenous DMT production. Refusing the appointment keeps sovereign consent intact.
